story: My health insurance company rejected my hospital claim saying the illness was pre-existing, but I told them everything when I bought the policy.
My car was damaged in an accident and the insurer refuses to pay the full claim, saying the repair estimate is too high.
The doctor operated on my father and made a mistake during the surgery. He got an infection and the hospital refused to take responsibility.
The hospital charged me far more than the estimate they gave and would not release the patient until I paid.
I paid for a flat five years ago and the builder still has not given me possession. I want my money back with interest.
The apartment I bought has a smaller carpet area than what the builder promised in the brochure.
Money was taken out of my account through my debit card in a transaction I never made, and the bank says it is not their fault.
The bank charged me a huge penalty when I closed my home loan early.
The new car I bought developed engine trouble within two months and the dealer will not replace it.
My washing machine stopped working within the warranty period and the company keeps delaying the repair.
I left the coaching institute after one month and they refuse to refund the course fees they took in advance.
The college collected the full fees but did not provide the course it promised during admission.
My electricity bill is many times higher than my normal usage and the department will not correct it.
My mobile company charged me for services I never used and does not fix the bill.
I ordered a phone online and received a different product. The seller refuses to return my money.
The railway ticket booking was cancelled but the refund never came to my account.
